newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet firm, attracts cargoes from east and west.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet firm, attracts cargoes from east and west.

text.p: NWE jet fuel premiums held firm in a quiet physical market on Monday, while outright prices climbed in line with benchmark gas oil futures.
Prompt buying interest was limited to 10,000-tonne cargoes, with bids at around Oct IPE +$35/$36 cif NWE, traders said.
But only larger cargoes from the Middle East and the Caribbean were seen offered, while a Libyan trader fixed a 25,000-tonne Ras Lanuf cargo for early October to the U.K.
"The prices on these cargoes (from outside the region) are tough, but they should work," a trader said.
